title: Assurance authority and external proof admission
lane_outcome: Close #2618 #2619 #2620 #2621 and #2622 with repo-owned classifiers, evidence authorities, external evidence admission, bounded dispositions, and source-bound requirement applications.
purpose_for_parent: Compose assurance and proof through the generic operating decision without provider-specific authority.
technical_strategy: Reuse proof-subject freshness and the ordinary operating decision; add one assurance admission module, Verification-owned producer authority declarations, and generated submit/query operations backed by package-trusted signed host custody.
technology_choices: Config-native and repo-owned classifiers share one application identity.
Verification manifest owns evidence-producer authority; transport stays non-authoritative.
External consumers pass opaque host-result references; authenticated producer facts cannot be submitted as JSON.
Strict closeout is the compatibility switch for legacy unbounded dispositions.
